svg.aria-label: The AI hiring funnel architecture showing candidate application stages, where algorithmic bias enters, and where statutory bias audits measure adverse impact.
svg.text: The AI Hiring Funnel: Screening Points & The Bias Audit
Applicant volume, feature extraction, algorithmic scoring, and regulatory audit checkpoints
1. Application Intake & Resume Parsing
Volume: 100,000+ unformatted applicant CVs
• NLP entity extraction: degrees, titles, skills
Bias risk: Non-standard formats & gendered terms
Candidates use GenAI CV optimizers to game keywords
2. Machine Learning Resume Ranker
Mechanism: Cosine similarity to top historical hires
• Trained on historical ten-year recruiter decisions
• Proxies: College pedigree, pin code, career gaps
Severe risk: Replicating historical demographic skew
3. Automated Skills & Video Scoring
Filters: Proctored coding tests & audio telemetry
• Psychometric game testing and technical puzzles
EU AI Act: Emotion recognition banned (Art. 5(1)(f))
Cutoff threshold eliminates 90% of applicant pool
4. Human Interview & Offer
Cohort: Final 3,000 candidates
• Structured behavioral panel interviews
• Copilot rubrics assist interviewers
Human in the loop completes hiring loop
5. The Statutory Bias Audit
NYC LL144 & EEOC 4/5ths Rule
• Selection Rate: SR = Selected / Total
• Adverse Impact Ratio: AIR = SR_grp / SR_max
• Statutory threshold: AIR >= 0.80 (80%)
Mandatory Audit Disclosures
• Annual independent third-party audit
• Publish selection rates by sex & ethnicity
• 10 business-day candidate pre-notice
EU AI Act High-Risk (Annex III.4)
• Mandatory conformity assessment & logging
DPDP Act: Consent notice for processing
